Almost nothing: the flow lines are the design
Pairs well with: black, bronze, deep red, chrome.
Not listed in the picker: ask the AI copilot for it by name.
pitfalls: Not mirror gold: it is a pale yellow with a grainy semi-matte feel
Not molten red: the red tag is only a few orange-brown streaks
Avoid: small numbers over the swirl, next to another loud finish.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 148 (strong pearl or anodized metal), roughness 144 (semi-matte), clearcoat 169 (dull or trace clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: small numbers over the swirl, next to another loud finish.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: the flow lines are the design; a solid black or deep brown number plate
Patterns to avoid: marble, wood or swirl patterns: duplicate the flow; flake: noise over the grain
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat spec to deepen the gold; fine metallic spec to lift the shimmer
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
